summary: Barrière will open Fouquet's Gstaad on 4 December 2026, the sixth Fouquet's address, in a property built as an Ultima flagship. It offers 11 suites and 6 apartments (33 bedrooms), a 1,500 m² private chalet, a spa of more than 800 m² and a Zuma pop-up. Ultima Capital keeps the real estate and Barrière operates.
title: Fouquet's Gstaad to open on 4 December
why: A French luxury brand enters the Swiss Alps through an owner–operator partnership rather than a purchase.
